meta.method: Tier B flood-day catalog: reports grouped by date (same day, or +/-1 day with non-exact date_confidence and overlapping areas); areas geocoded with pipeline/geocode.py (Nominatim, 1 req/s, cached), with a district fallback (text after the last comma, or a known district inside the string) at confidence 'neighbourhood' for full names that fail; rain signature from events/rain_history_grid_daily.json (IMERG WAT daily totals), including the local block: rain at the flooded areas' own cells for the flood day and the day before; population-weighted rain as in catalog_ranked.json (GHSL epoch nearest the flood year); candidates matched from catalog_ranked.json within +/-1 day; promotion per docs/INTAKE_PLAN.md decision 3

grouping.adjacent_days: +/-1 day only when a date_confidence is not 'exact' and areas overlap
grouping.area_overlap: same normalized name or geocoded points within 2.0 km

geocoding.district_fallback: for a failed full name: retry with the text after the last comma, or a known district name inside the string; a district followed by a route word is part of a route name, not the district
geocoding.lga_exclusion: fallbacks accept place-level hits only; LGA/boundary and highway hits are excluded
geocoding.geocoded_from: the fallback query that resolved the area (null for full-name hits)

promotion_rule.deaths: a death word (swept away, drowned, died, dead, killed, bodies, ...) in any report of the day, with the official or named attribution in that report or any other report of the same day (NEMA, LASEMA, LASTMA, police, named officials); deaths_note records the sources
promotion_rule.structure: an official cause attribution with a human cause tag (not heavy_rain/lagoon_tide/dam_release) whose cause quote names a physical structure: canal, channel, collector, drain system number, bridge, culvert, outfall or named road project

rain.local: rain at the geocoded areas' own cells: max and median total_mm for the flood day and the day before; local_max_2d_mm = the largest per-cell day + previous-day sum; max_30min_mm_h_2d = the highest 30-min rate over both days; null when the day has no geocoded area
rain.drainage_signal: share of checkable flood days (>= 1 geocoded area and IMERG coverage) with local_max_2d_mm < 20.0 mm; the AOI mean is kept as context

impacts: Heavy rainfall from about 8 am submerged an Agege community and trapped pupils in Ladoje Nursery and Primary School; motorists and commuters trapped in traffic; Yaba road flooded.

Overnight rain from about 2:15 am, full force by 3:15 am; canal overflowed. An 11-year-old boy and rescuer Wasiu ('Wasiu Stubborn') swept into the Aboru–Iyana-Ipaja canal on Ige Road. Furniture maker Gift Wejem said flood had swept away furniture, materials, machines and a generator when the canal overflowed.
Same Saturday canal overflow as r2019-009: 11-year-old boy and rescuer Wasiu swept into the canal.

Correspondents monitored Friday–Sunday. Saturday: Magodo building collapse (Jumiah Utache and three children — collapse, not a flood drowning); Aboru boy and Wasiu; landlord Aina Oke, Abule Egba, fence collapsed on two SUVs. Lekki flood covered at least 1.4 km on Bola Ahmed Tinubu Avenue and Bogije. Four vehicles trapped on Agric-Isawo Road. Awoyaya residents walked through flood. Gridlock and destroyed homes at Jakande, Lekki, Ebute-Meta, Ijegun, Idimu, Agege, Randle and Maryland.

BBC Pidgin: non-stop heavy rain, flood everywhere; two buildings collapsed (Magodo and Ita Elewa, Ikorodu); four dead in Magodo collapse (mother, two children, sister) per LASEMA. Some people said rain plus flood contributed to collapse; LASEMA also cited construction/stress on the Ikorodu mud-brick building.

impacts: Saturday morning rain from 5.00 a.m. for hours; flood blocked Trade Fair axis; passengers trekked from Abule-Ado to Barracks in Ojo; vehicles trapped. NAN: floods also affected Badagry communities Mowo, Ikoga, Ansarudeen, Ajara-Vetho, Aghelaso and Zogakome.

Early-morning Saturday downpour; flood took over major areas; residents in Alimosho, Agege and Ikeja bailed storm water from houses; flood later receded. Motorists said flood takes over Oko Filling bus stop on LASU–Igando Expressway whenever it rains.

Rain about 2am–2pm Saturday. Motorcycle rider Mr Abe swept away on Ile Epo Bus Stop canal (NEMA SW coordinator Ibrahim Farinloye). Houses, offices and roads submerged in Papa Ashafa and Fashola. NEMA: immediate succour to about 200 people in Orile Agege that afternoon; DG Mustapha Ahmed ordered relief for people in four churches. Ago-Palace residents battling flood water in homes.

Early-morning rain submerged houses; residents bailed water; flood overflowed drains into houses; some fences and gates destroyed; some families temporarily relocated. NEMA Farinloye: assistance to about 200 people in Orile Agege that afternoon; helping reconstruct a collapsed fence.

Published Sunday 17 Sept: heavy flood swept away a commercial motorcycle at Papa Ashafa yesterday; rider Mr Abe, per NEMA's Ibrahim Farinlonye. Third Mainland Bridge palliative works postponed because of Saturday downpour.
